title: Systems That Connect
subtitle: Design organizations, AI workflows and platform decisions that hold from API to interface

bio.short: I build design organizations and the systems they ship. At Ninox I led five people and temporarily carried Product across nine people and four disciplines. My current work combines production-API prototypes, live AI and n8n workflows, and cross-platform design infrastructure. The throughline is turning complex workflows into reusable product capabilities for builders, operators, partners and end users.
bio.long:
At Ninox I led five people, including a design lead, and owned the design function's operating model: capacity, allocation, prioritization, team structure and processes. During a critical transition I also held Product, bringing the scope to nine people across product design, UX writing, product management and data science. I later returned as an independent consultant to design prompt-to-database AI onboarding with the founders. The generated schema appears in the real data-model editor so builders can inspect and correct it.

At Bibel TV I lead product design and remain close to implementation. I prototype against production APIs, and the external engineering agency ships from that code. I built a token system designed to serve iOS, Android, web and connected TV from one source. I also shipped a human-operated support copilot. Live-tested n8n workflows turn timed transcripts into source-linked material for an AI Bible experience.

The same platform judgment appears in earlier work. At ChurchDesk I turned a customer-specific booking request into an integrated capability for funerals, room rentals, baptisms and weddings. It reduced coordination time by 70% with 90% booking acceptance at the launch customer. At Datameer I led design across Germany and New York while working on technical data products for major banks and insurers.

context.company: Deel is becoming a platform whose connectivity layer spans APIs, developer experience, partners, an app ecosystem, internal tools and AI-native customer surfaces.
context.role: Director, Product Design – Connectivity. The role builds and runs the design organization and co-owns platform strategy with Product and Engineering. It remains close enough to the work to unblock launches and raise craft quality.
context.emphasis: Lead with the pairing of organization building and current hands-on AI and platform work. Show repeated workflow-to-platform decisions across Ninox, ChurchDesk, Datameer and Bibel TV, with visible evidence of technical constraints, multi-sided products and measurable outcomes.
